name: Aerotheurge
description: Aerotheurge increase all Air damage you deal.

name: Geomancer
description: Geomancer increases all Poison and Earth damage you deal, and any Physical Armor restoration you cause.

name: Huntsman
description: Huntsman increases high ground advantage bonuses and decreases low ground penalties.

name: Hydrosophist
description: Hydrosophist increases all Water damage you deal, and any Vitality healing or Magic Armor restoration that you cause.

name: Necromancer
description: Necromancer heals you every time you deal damage to Vitality.

name: Polymorph
description: Polymorph provides one free attribute point per point invested.

name: Pyrokinetic
description: Pyrokinetic increase all Fire damage you deal.

name: Scoundrel
description: Scoundrel increase movement speed and boosts your Critical Modifier.

name: Summoning
description: Summoning increases Vitality, Damage, Physical Armor and Magical Armor of your summons and totems.

name: Warfare
description: Warfare increases all Physical damage dealt.

name: Special
description: Special skills in Divinity: Original Sin 2 are a collection of different but strong skills. Many of them are acquired during Character Creation or can only be used by certain Companions.

name: Sourcery
description: Sourcery Skills (not to be confused with Source skills) are a set of skills that is integral to the story of Divinity: Original Sin 2. As you progress through the game you'll come across points where you must interact with the Divine, and will grant you these skills to help your ascension into godhood.
